transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me, I really appreciate it. I hope I'm not wasting your time... I know you must be very busy with people who are much sicker than I am. 

Um, I guess I came in because I've just been feeling... well, really tired lately. I try to push through it, I really do, but I'm so tired I can barely get through a shift at work. I'm a cashier, so I know I shouldn't be this exhausted, but it just feels like my body is filled with wet sand. And even when I try to rest, it doesn't really bring me back to normal. 

Is that... does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay for you.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Sad? Um... no, I don't think so. I really try to stay positive, especially for the customers at work. I wouldn't want you to think I'm just sitting around crying or, you know, feeling sorry for myself. I know I have a lot to be thankful for. 

It's really just the exhaustion... that heavy feeling I mentioned. I'm usually a pretty upbeat person, I promise. I just don't have the energy I usually do. Does that make sense? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of information.
Have you noticed any change in the things you enjoy doing?

Um... well, I really try to keep up with my hobbies, I do. I don't want to seem like I'm just giving up or anything. But... lately, I guess things just haven't felt the same. 

I usually love cooking nice meals for myself, or playing my guitar, and I used to go hiking a lot... or even just visiting my family's place on the weekends. But recently, it all just feels... kind of flat? Like I'm going through the motions and just pretending to care, even though I really want to enjoy it. 

I hope that doesn't sound terrible. I know I should be more grateful for the things I get to do. Am I making sense? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Um... well, I try to keep a good routine, I promise. But with the changing shifts at work, it’s been a little tricky lately. I don't want to complain, because I'm really glad to have the hours, but... I got to a point where I’d only sleep a few hours and still feel completely wired. Like I didn't even need the rest, which I know probably sounds silly. 

And now... well, now even when I’m just so completely exhausted, I’ll wake up really early and my mind is already just going and going. I try to stay in bed and force myself to rest, I really do, but my brain just won't shut off. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm not making a big deal out of nothing, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the full picture.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?

Um... well, I always try to make sure I eat enough to keep my strength up for work, I really do. I don't want to seem like I'm neglecting myself. But... I guess my appetite has been a little all over the place lately. 

I don't know, it's just... lately, I mostly just forget to eat? Or when I do, it kind of just tastes like cardboard. I still try to force myself to eat something, I promise. But... I have noticed my work pants are fitting a little looser than normal. 

I hope that's not too concerning. I know I should be doing a better job of taking care of myself. Is that the kind of thing you needed to know? I just want to make sure I'm being helpful.
Do you often feel guilty about things that happen in your life?

Um... well, I really try my best to do a good job and be there for everyone, I promise I do. I don't want you to think I'm just sitting around feeling sorry for myself. But... yeah, I guess I do feel bad about things a lot. 

It's just... I keep thinking I let everybody down, you know? Like my manager at the store, or my family, or even my little nieces. I try so hard to be good for them, but then I'll make a mistake at the cash register, even a small one, and I just replay it over and over in my head. It just makes me feel like... like it proves I'm no good, or that I'm just messing everything up. 

I know I shouldn't be so hard on myself, and I really try to stay positive. I hope it doesn't sound like I'm just whining. Am I answering your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to be alive lately?

Um... well... I know I probably shouldn't say this, and I really don't want you to think I'm crazy or... or ungrateful for my life, because I know I have a lot to be thankful for. I really do try to stay positive, I promise. 

But... yeah, lately... I guess I've had some kind of scary thoughts. Just... sometimes I think maybe everyone would be better off if I just didn't wake up. Like I wouldn't be such a burden anymore. And... um... a few times, when I've been walking home from the store, I've caught myself looking at the cars and... and thinking about just stepping off the curb into traffic. 

I wouldn't actually do it, I swear! I know that's a terrible thing to even think about, and I feel so guilty for even letting it cross my mind. I try to push it away right away. I hope you're not mad at me for saying that. I just... I wanted to be honest since you asked. Is it okay that I told you that?
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... well, I really hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is. I've been trying so hard to just push through it and do a good job at work, I really have. But... I guess this really low, empty feeling... it's been hanging around for a while now. 

Maybe... maybe about four months? It started a while after I had this... this really big rush of energy at the store, where I was just doing everything so fast and feeling so great. But then that passed, and since then it's just been this sort of heavy, sad feeling that won't go away. 

I know four months sounds like a long time to just let it go on, and I really should have tried harder to snap out of it sooner. I promise I've been trying to stay busy. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining the timeline okay for you.
Have you experienced any unusual perceptions, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't, lately?

Um... well... I know this is going to sound really strange, and I really, really don't want you to think I'm losing my mind or anything. I know it's probably just stress from wanting to do a good job at work... I try so hard to make sure every customer is happy. 

But... um... yeah, lately, while I'm at the register... I've been hearing things. It's like... I'll hear voices, like customers are standing right behind me, just whispering. Sometimes they're whispering my name, or... or saying that I'm messing everything up and doing a terrible job. But then I turn around to apologize or see what they need, and... nobody is there. 

I know it sounds crazy, and I promise I know they aren't really there! I try to just ignore it and keep smiling for the real customers. I really hope you don't think less of me for saying that. Is it okay that I told you? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you experienced any other unusual perceptions, like seeing things that others can't, lately?

Um... no, no, I haven't seen anything like that. I really hope I didn't make it sound like I was seeing things, too. I just... it's just the whispering sometimes. 

I promise my vision is completely fine, and I'm not seeing things that aren't there. I'm really trying my best to stay grounded, you know? I wouldn't want you to think things are worse than they actually are. I'm just trying to be as honest as I can about the voices. Is that... is that what you needed to know?
Have you had any thoughts of self-harm or suicide more frequently than just those few times you mentioned?

Um... well... I really don't want you to worry too much about this. I know it's bad to think this way, and I'm really trying to just focus on being a good employee and a good person. 

But... I guess... sometimes the thoughts do get a little bit scary. It's not like I actually want to do anything, I promise! It's just... sometimes I think maybe everyone would be better off if I just... didn't wake up in the morning. And... um... a couple of times, just when I was walking home from work, I sort of caught myself thinking about... about stepping off the curb into traffic. 

But I didn't do it! I would never want to cause an accident or make a mess for anyone else. I know I shouldn't think like that, and I'm really trying to just push those thoughts away. I hope you're not disappointed in me for having them. I'm just trying to be honest with you... is it okay that I shared that?
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Um... well, I really hope this doesn't make me sound lazy or ungrateful for the things I have. I know I should be happy and keeping busy. 

But... I guess lately, things I usually love doing just... don't feel the same. Like, I usually really enjoy cooking nice meals for myself, or playing my guitar, or even just going for a hike or visiting my family's place. But recently, it's just... it all feels kind of flat. 

I still do them sometimes! I really try to keep up appearances because I don't want my family to worry, but... it feels like I'm only pretending to care about those things right now. I just can't seem to find the joy in them. I know I should try harder to be positive. I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions the right way.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating on tasks at work or at home lately?

Um... well, I really try my hardest to stay focused, I promise. I don't want my manager to think I'm slacking off or anything, because I usually pride myself on being a really good worker. 

But... I guess, maybe a little bit? It's just... at work—I'm a cashier—and lately, when I'm ringing people up, it feels like every little thing just completely catches my attention. Like, every single scanner beep, or... they're doing a remodel in the store right now, so whenever I hear a drill noise, or even just a person walking past my lane... it just pulls my focus completely away. And then I kind of lose track of what I was doing with the customer's items. 

I always fix it right away, though! And I make sure to smile and apologize to them, so no one has complained. I really don't want you to think I'm bad at my job or incapable of working... I'm trying so hard to just push through it and do things right. Is that... does that answer your question okay?
Have you noticed yourself moving slower or faster than usual lately?

Um... well, I really try to keep busy and be a good employee, so I hope this doesn't sound like I'm complaining or being lazy. 

But... I guess it's actually been a little bit of both? Like, at first, a little while ago, I was moving really fast. I just couldn't stop pacing around the store and straightening all the displays and candy racks. I just wanted everything to look absolutely perfect for the customers! 

But... um... lately, it's kind of gone the other way. I really don't want you to think I'm letting myself go, but... everything just feels really slowed down and heavy right now. Even just walking to the bus stop after work, or... or even just taking a second to answer a question when someone talks to me. It's like I'm moving through water. 

I still make sure to get all my work done, though, I promise! I just have to push myself a little harder to keep up the pace. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right for you.
Have you had any periods where you felt extremely happy or irritable for no reason?

Um... well, I really hope this doesn't make me sound like a difficult person, because I really try to be friendly and get along with everyone. I know how important it is to have a good attitude. 

But... I guess there was a time, a little while back, where I felt... just really, really great. Like, almost unstoppable? I was just so cheerful and full of energy, and I wanted to talk to all the customers and make everyone smile. I thought I was just being a really good employee! 

But then... um... I feel so terrible admitting this, because I'm usually not like this at all... but during that same time, I would get so easily frustrated. Like, if my manager asked me to count my drawer again, or if a customer was just taking a little too long, I would just... snap. I got so irritable over the smallest things, and it wasn't like me at all. 

I always apologized right away if I was short with anyone, though! I really didn't mean to be rude, it just felt like my mood was jumping all over the place. I really hope you don't think I'm a mean person... I'm usually very patient. Does that... is that the kind of thing you were asking about?
Have you had any thoughts of self-harm or suicide more than a few times a week?

Um... well... I really don't want you to worry about me, or think I'm, you know, unstable or a danger to myself. I really try to stay positive and be strong, I promise I do. 

But... um... things have just felt so heavy lately, like I mentioned. And... I guess I have had some kind of scary thoughts. Not all the time! Just... maybe a little more than I'd like to admit. It's just... sometimes I think maybe everyone would be better off if I just didn't wake up in the morning. It would just be easier for my manager, and my family, and... everyone. 

And... um... please don't be upset with me, but a few times recently, when I've been walking to the bus stop after work... I've caught myself looking at the cars and just... thinking about stepping off the curb into traffic. 

I haven't done it, though! I always stop myself and just wait for the bus like a normal person. I would never want to cause a scene or make anyone feel bad. I'm really trying my best to just keep going and do my job. Is it... is it okay that I told you that? I hope I'm not making things too difficult for you.
Have you been experiencing these feelings of heaviness and sadness most of the day, nearly every day?

Um... no, I don't think so. I really try my best not to let myself get stuck like that, so I wouldn't say it's all day, or every single day. 

I still have okay moments, I promise! Like, if a customer is really sweet at the register, or if my manager says I did a good job organizing the bags, I can still smile and feel perfectly fine for a bit. I really want to be a positive person, so I try to focus on those good parts. 

It's just... it kind of comes and goes, I guess? I always try to shake off that heavy feeling as quick as I can so I can keep being productive. I hope I didn't make it sound worse than it is when I was talking earlier... I'm really trying not to be a complainer, and I definitely don't feel sad every single minute. Did I... did I answer that okay for you?
Have you been experiencing these feelings of sadness and heaviness for at least two weeks?

Um... well... I know two weeks sounds like a long time to feel down, and I really wish I could say it was just a couple of days. I hate being a downer, I really do. But... um... if I'm being completely honest with you, and I really want to make sure I'm answering you properly... it's been quite a bit longer than two weeks. 

That low, kind of empty part... it's actually lasted for about four months now. It started a long time after that first big rush of energy I had at work finally passed. I kept hoping if I just smiled more and focused on the customers, it would go away, but it's just kind of lingered since then. 

I'm so sorry I haven't been able to just snap out of it on my own. I really have been trying my hardest to fix it! Is... is it helpful that I told you the exact timeline? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so I'm not wasting your time.
Have you been experiencing significant weight loss or gain due to your decreased appetite?

Um... well, I really try to make sure I'm taking care of myself, I promise I do. I know how important it is to eat right so I can do a good job at work. But... um... honestly, my appetite has just been kind of all over the place lately. 

I don't want you to think I'm starving myself or anything like that! It's just... recently, I mostly just forget to eat, or when I do try to force something down, it just tastes like cardboard. I really try to finish my meals, but it's been hard. And... um... I guess I have noticed that my work pants have been fitting a lot looser lately. I had to pull my belt a notch tighter the other day. 

I'm sorry, I know I should be paying better attention to my eating habits. I'll try to do better, I really will! Does... does that answer your question okay? I hope I'm being helpful.
Have you been feeling hopeless about your future most of the time?

Um... hopeless? Oh, no, I wouldn't use a strong word like that. I really try to keep a positive outlook on things, you know? I think it's so important to look on the bright side. 

I mean, sure, sometimes when I'm feeling really heavy and tired, it's a little hard to picture exactly what's coming next, or how I'm going to get everything done. But I always tell myself that things will get better if I just keep working hard and trying my best. I don't want to be the kind of person who just gives up on the future. 

I really try to focus on the good things that could happen, like maybe getting more hours at the store or finally feeling like myself again. So... no, not hopeless. Just... maybe a little unsure sometimes? But I'm working on being more optimistic, I promise! Is... is it okay that I feel that way? I hope that's the right kind of attitude to have.
